name: dobe_dive_key
desc: Change the pose into a perfect, elegant head-first dive like an Olympic diver: the whole huge goo body is lifted off the floor and stretched into a straight diagonal line pointing down to the lower left, both thick arms extended straight together beyond the head with the hands pressed together like a blade, chest broad, the gooey lower body trailing behind as a long tapered tail of dripping paint instead of a puddle. Smug face. Same design, colors, yellow marble streaks, outline and pixel art style. Nothing touches the floor.
